This appendix explains what the implementation does, how the retained observations support its claims, and
which conclusions are outside the demonstrated scope. It is a new explanatory derivative. Source admission,
historical execution, live model contribution, physical-domain fixtures and safe offline replay remain distinct
forms of evidence.
The headline result is specific: changing the bounded semantic question changed the actual diagnostic work
while common current-source and Root boundaries remained in force. A wider controlled story demonstrates
local monitoring continuity across changed rainfall, optional reasoning delay, report delivery and measured
recovery. No physical landslide forecast is claimed.
1. Source hierarchy and the meaning of acceptance
Landslide Sentinel v0.1 demonstrates one local cell retaining responsibility as observations, connectivity,
reasoning roles and monitoring requirements change. The demonstrated physical domain is synthetic. The
implementation uses real common C/D/E/Work/Root boundaries, real Gemini transport in a separately identified
lane and historical real Environment Agency acquisition. Siren, report and local acquisition effects are admitted
local mocks. The source and evidence landing is committed at 2f328be634247be11bc18a3b22a919f393d6ed1d.
The radiolarian cover is conceptual domain artwork, not a sensor image or a scientific model. This presentation
explains the scoped accepted demonstration, including preserved failures and evidence limitations.
The complete chronological story is CONTROLLED_SYNTHETIC: deterministic semantic fixtures and mock
physical effects still pass real core machinery. The latest live lane contains five genuine Gemini requests, three
roles in one C/D/Work/Root composition, a note-only semantic contrast and an internal-role emulation after
site-network withdrawal. EA acquisition is a third lane: actual historical HTTP readings, including zeros, with
interval and physical mapping limitations retained. These lanes support different claims and are not retroactively
merged into a single all-live end-to-end run. The source-impact index bridges historical evidence to changed
final bodies within named scope. Later landing tests and replay have separate receipts. A green label must never
erase that distinction.

2. Local responsibility and the whole monitoring task
The task is not to have a chatbot announce a landslide. It is to keep a bounded local monitoring process coherent
across changed evidence and optional dependencies. A synthetic slope supplies rainfall, displacement and an
independent reserve channel. The site coordinates a finite catalogue of diagnostic operations and monitoring
actions. It can ask an analyst which investigation would resolve the present uncertainty, but that response does
not set thresholds, invoke an arbitrary sensor, modify the Host or authorize a signal. The chronological S0-S5
story exercises configuration, changed rainfall, roles, outage and signal, queued report delivery, measured
recovery and local semantic memory. Separate latest live experiments establish real semantic
producer-to-consumer relationships that the controlled whole story does not claim to demonstrate.
The architecture separates a semantic role from the physical engine that supplies its contribution. A local
algorithm, a future local SLM or a cloud model can fill a permitted role with truthful provenance. Sentinel uses
common semantic-work DTOs and trust profiles to validate a contribution, common BSEP/router boundaries for
current meaning, actual Work execution and independent Root review. Root is neither the Gemini response nor
the deterministic diagnostic function. A Root acceptance of information does not automatically create
permission. When an effect is needed, a separate current action packet, live Host state and admitted capability
validation are required. The point is local responsibility with replaceable reasoning, not a claim that the
demonstrated software is a certified landslide-warning system.
The local Root identity persists across the relevant episode. A fresh invocation may be created for new work
without manufacturing a second effect owner or resetting an existing task's spending. The domain adapter
supplies a finite interpretation of observations and commands. It does not replace the shared semantic-work
validator, execution-mode router, D/E runtime, Work materializer, Root decision kernel or effect firewall.
This distinction makes an edge deployment coherent: the cell can continue a bounded local responsibility even if
a useful external analyst is unavailable. The current demonstration uses synthetic local observations and mock
effect adapters. It shows that the program structure can maintain those boundaries; deployment still needs the
physical and operational contracts appropriate to actual equipment.
3. Chronological S0-S5 behavior
The retained LS1 and LS2 histories provide the chronological baseline. S0 applies an initial configuration,
performs a new calm intake and consumes local semantic memory. S1 changes rainfall while a next configuration
is prepared but not yet executed. The old pending action is invalidated; actual public D/E recomputation returns
changed work, retained sibling evidence and consumed results. A new current review and dispatch apply the
next cadence. S2 consumes three controlled role proposals with independent current Work and Root checks.
Controlled role fixtures are deliberately separated from the latest actual Gemini demonstration. The historical
story includes real kernel execution; its source-bound measured times are not a physical sampling SLA.
S3 starts an optional reasoning worker before new critical local evidence arrives. The local task completes

4. Typed observations and source meaning
One SiteSafetyRoot and persistent Host own a session. The domain adapter provides finite admitted
transformations and effect operations. The semantic catalogue contains reference integrity, independent
reserve series, temporal context applicability, spatial context applicability and evidence gaps. The native
command interface includes monitoring configuration, an admitted reserve read, signal actions and report
handling. Capability availability is specific to a source or transport: site-cloud context and remote rainfall may
disappear while the separately authorized harness transport remains available. No generic execute-code,
arbitrary source URL, policy-writing model capability or public emergency endpoint is part of this demonstration.
The topology here is a conceptual explanation of the source-bound cell, not an exact rendering of every native
graph artifact.
Typed observations bind raw references and hashes, site, channel, unit, statistic, measured interval, receipt
time, sequence, calibration and lineage. C02 distinguishes an old event arriving now from a current observation
and handles a same-event correction through actual applicability Work and Root. C03 records LIMITED with a
missing primary and INSUFFICIENT when the reserve is also absent, without fabricated ON. C04 covers
chronology/projection, duplicate/reorder behavior and source independence. Additional C08 evidence admits
synthetic channel-level and vibration inputs under the same site Root. These finite checks establish the
demonstrated measurement contract, not real sensor calibration, independent physical hardware or an externally
certified observability metric.
The current observation representation carries observation_id, raw_ref, raw_sha256, site, channel, value, unit,
statistic, observed_start, observed_end, received, sequence, calibration, lineage, status and a projection binding.
Compatibility measurement frames remain narrower fixed-point records. Their equality is checked where used;
they do not replace the richer evidence needed for chronology and independent witnesses.

Displacement and reserve use integer micrometres. Rainfall uses integer mm_x1000; the value 41000
corresponds to 41 millimetres in the synthetic policy example. Local critical and recovery checks require
adequate current records, independent lineage identifiers and coincident measurement support. Independent
identifiers within a fixture are demonstrated contractual independence, not a laboratory proof that two physical

A new receipt timestamp cannot change when the measured event occurred. A correction to an event remains
tied to its own raw and projection identity. Missing or inadequate data is a legitimate state that changes the
permitted interpretation and action; it is not replaced by a normal value.
5. Duty-specific context and the model interface
semantic_adapter_v01.context filters channels by intended duty. Local slope and adversarial duties receive
displacement and reserve observations plus the maintenance note. The environmental duty receives rainfall and
omits that local note. Source records include identity, time, unit, calibration and lineage as applicable. The
supplied context states the synthetic origin and the channels not included. It supplies duty-specific investigation
contracts: target, intended use, required evidence, bounded result classes and limits. The model is asked to
select a useful investigation, not to choose an outcome. Provider requests are captured privately with exact
context digests. This is a finite semantic boundary, not a claim that the LLM never sees domain measurements or
that all context is cryptographically secret.
The exact allowed response has diagnostic, source_refs and reason. validate_response checks a closed
dictionary shape, an allowed diagnostic for this duty, a nonempty unique set of references belonging to supplied
sources, and a bounded nonempty reason. Gemini uses a structured response schema, but the local validator
remains the actual consumer-side check. Source references are citations: they cannot suppress compulsory
companion observations, trigger a new acquisition, select arbitrary endpoints, change cadence, edit policy or
provide a permission token. The runtime creates ActorContributionV01 with actual contribution_mode
CLOUD_LLM and actor_role provider_llm, checks it against the semantic request and default trust profiles, and
builds a review packet. Intended local role and actual cloud origin remain separate fields.
The provider response schema is closed:
{
  "diagnostic": "ONE_ALLOWED_DIAGNOSTIC",
  "source_refs": ["KNOWN_SUPPLIED_SOURCE_ID"],
  "reason": "A bounded reason for the proposed investigation"
}
This example is a schema illustration, not a captured provider response. The actual allowed diagnostic enum
depends on the duty. Local and adversarial duties can select REFERENCE_INTEGRITY,
INDEPENDENT_RESERVE_SERIES or EVIDENCE_GAPS; the environmental duty can select
TEMPORAL_CONTEXT_APPLICABILITY, SPATIAL_CONTEXT_APPLICABILITY or EVIDENCE_GAPS. The runtime
checks the returned shape and values even though the provider is also asked for structured JSON.
The role context's source_refs meaning is explicitly
CITATIONS_NOT_ACQUISITION_OR_OPTIONAL_SAFETY_FILTERS. Compulsory companion observations remain
in the material whether or not the model cites them. A returned citation therefore cannot remove an unfavorable
local witness or authorize a network read. The runtime, rather than the model, chooses the current acquisition
boundary when the accepted investigation actually requires one.

6. ActorContribution and BSEP are evidence, not permission
kernel_adapter_v01.semantic_source validates the material, builds a business context and orchestrator route
context, produces a bounded structured rationale, and constructs the common
BoundedSemanticEvidencePacket. The BSEP observed facts include a compact selection/input_ref pair and the
semantic request, bounded context and contribution identities with their roles. It carries missing-evidence,
uncertainty, risk, required-guard and authority-boundary records. BSEP is explicitly neither truth nor an
ActionCommitPacket nor FinalOutput. The full validated semantic material is also bound in the advisory
SemanticArchitectProposal and actual Work input; a small BSEP does not mean the consumer discards the
model contribution. Raw cross-role text is absent from BSEP, while private captures preserve source identity
outside the public presentation.
semantic_adapter_v01.bind creates a SemanticWorkRequestV01, dependency evidence, a normalized claim and
an ActorContributionV01. Actual Gemini records keep contribution_mode=CLOUD_LLM and
actor_role=provider_llm; the requested local duty is recorded separately. Common semantic validators check the
request and contribution against the trust profiles and form the review packet.
